senses.en: to cover something by folding material around it
a loose piece of clothing worn around the shoulders
a thin flat bread rolled around a filling

ex.en: She wrapped the birthday present in bright yellow paper.
Retailers could reduce packaging waste by encouraging customers to wrap gifts in reusable fabric.

col: wrap something in paper｜bọc vật gì trong giấy
tip: Dùng wrap A in B nghĩa là dùng chất liệu B để bọc A.

senses.zh: tính cách; phẩm chất; nét đặc trưng
senses.en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.

col: strength of character｜sức mạnh nhân cách
tip: Nghĩa “nhân vật, ký tự” đếm được; nghĩa phẩm chất nói chung thường không đếm được.

senses.en: the chance that something might happen or be true

senses.zh: lựa chọn có thể cân nhắc; điều có thể xảy ra
senses.en: something that might happen or could be chosen

ex.en: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
Improved public transport increases the possibility that commuters will leave their cars at home.

col: a real possibility｜khả năng có thật
explore the possibilities｜khám phá các lựa chọn khả dĩ
rule out the possibility｜loại trừ khả năng
tip: Thường dùng possibility of doing hoặc possibility that + mệnh đề.

senses.en: not one or the other of two
not either of two people or things
used to add another negative statement

ex.en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.

col: neither of them｜cả hai người đó đều không
neither option｜cả hai lựa chọn đều không
tip: neither chỉ dùng cho hai đối tượng; theo sau là danh từ số ít, thường đi với nor.

senses.en: Put your arms around someone and hold them close
An act of holding someone close with your arms

ex.en: Lena hugged her grandmother before leaving for school.
A reassuring hug from a parent can help young children manage stress in unfamiliar situations.

col: a warm hug｜cái ôm ấm áp
tip: Quá khứ hugged, V-ing hugging đều gấp đôi chữ g.

senses.zh: có ý nghĩa lịch sử; nổi tiếng trong lịch sử
senses.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.

col: historic event｜sự kiện mang tính lịch sử
historic agreement｜thỏa thuận có ý nghĩa lịch sử
tip: historic nhấn mạnh ý nghĩa lịch sử; historical chỉ chung liên quan đến lịch sử.

senses.en: Happening or needed now, without any delay.
Closest in space, time, or relationship.
Directly connected to something, without anything coming between.

ex.en: The leaking pipe needs immediate attention before the kitchen floods.
Governments should take immediate action to protect communities facing severe water shortages during prolonged droughts.

col: immediate action｜hành động ngay lập tức
tip: immediate là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho động từ dùng immediately.

senses.en: a curved band of colours appearing in the sky after rain
a collection or range of many different colours

ex.en: A bright rainbow appeared above the hills after lunch.
Tourists often photograph the rainbow that forms in the spray near the base of the waterfall.

col: a rainbow appears｜cầu vồng xuất hiện
a rainbow of colours｜muôn màu sắc rực rỡ
tip: Thường là danh từ đếm được; a rainbow of chỉ một dải màu sắc rực rỡ.

senses.en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents.
A soft, silver-coloured metal used to coat other metals.

ex.en: There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
Reusing a metal tin for storage can reduce household waste and the need for new containers.

col: a tin of soup｜một hộp súp
tip: Nghĩa “hộp” đếm được, tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng tin, tiếng Anh Mỹ hay dùng can; thiếc không đếm được.

senses.en: A piece of work someone is required to complete.

senses.zh: sự phân công; sự chỉ định
senses.en: The act of giving someone a task, role, or place.

ex.en: I finished my science assignment before dinner last night.
A group assignment can help students develop communication skills and learn to share responsibility.

col: complete an assignment｜hoàn thành bài tập hoặc nhiệm vụ
assignment of duties｜phân công nhiệm vụ
tip: Chỉ bài tập cụ thể thì đếm được; homework thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react.
A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.

ex.en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.

col: analytical chemist｜nhà hóa học phân tích
research chemist｜nhà nghiên cứu hóa học
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh còn chỉ dược sĩ; chemist's thường là hiệu thuốc.

senses.zh: nguyên âm; chữ cái nguyên âm
senses.en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.

ex.en: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.

tip: Chọn a hay an dựa vào âm đầu của từ theo sau có phải nguyên âm hay không, không dựa vào chữ cái.

senses.en: Very surprised by something unexpected.

ex.en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.

col: be amazed to discover｜ngạc nhiên khi phát hiện
tip: amazed tả cảm giác của người; amazing tả điều đáng kinh ngạc.

senses.zh: giá trị; giá cả; tầm quan trọng
senses.en: the worth, price, or importance of something

senses.zh: coi trọng; trân trọng; định giá
senses.en: consider something important or estimate how much it is worth
beliefs about what is right and important in life

ex.en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.

col: place a high value on｜đánh giá cao
property value｜giá trị bất động sản
tip: Nghĩa “giá trị quan” dùng số nhiều values.

senses.en: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.

col: a severe thunderstorm｜trận giông bão dữ dội
a thunderstorm warning｜cảnh báo giông bão
tip: thunder là tiếng sấm, lightning là tia chớp; cả hiện tượng gọi là thunderstorm.

senses.zh: kiến trúc học; thiết kế kiến trúc
senses.en: The art and practice of designing buildings.
The style and appearance of buildings.
The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.

ex.en: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.

col: sustainable architecture｜thiết kế kiến trúc bền vững
tip: architecture thường không đếm được; architect chỉ kiến trúc sư.

senses.zh: ích kỷ; chỉ nghĩ đến mình
senses.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

ex.en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.

col: selfish of someone｜ích kỷ khi làm vậy
tip: Nhận xét hành vi của ai dùng It is selfish of sb to do.

senses.zh: nhân viên văn phòng; thư ký
senses.en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks

senses.zh: nhân viên bán hàng; lễ tân
senses.en: someone serving customers in a shop or at a desk

ex.en: The clerk checked my details and handed me a form.
Although digital services are expanding, many residents still prefer discussing complex applications with a trained clerk.

tip: Tiếng Anh Anh đọc nguyên âm /ɑː/; trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thường chỉ nhân viên bán hàng.

senses.en: an object or machine designed for a particular purpose
a method used to achieve an effect or particular result

ex.en: This tiny device tracks my steps throughout the day.
A portable medical device can help patients monitor their health without frequent hospital visits.

col: an electronic device｜thiết bị điện tử
a medical device｜thiết bị y tế
a safety device｜thiết bị an toàn
a literary device｜thủ pháp văn học
tip: device là danh từ; devise là động từ, nghĩa là nghĩ ra hoặc thiết kế.

senses.en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion.
Providing a faster service than usual.
Clearly and directly stated.

ex.en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.

col: express concern｜bày tỏ mối lo ngại
express delivery｜dịch vụ chuyển phát nhanh
express permission｜sự cho phép rõ ràng
tip: Khi là động từ, theo sau là tân ngữ trực tiếp, như express your views.

senses.zh: phiếu giảm giá; phiếu quà tặng
senses.en: A ticket or code giving a discount or free item.

senses.zh: lãi suất trái phiếu; phiếu lãi
senses.en: An interest payment on a bond, or its claiming slip.

ex.en: This coupon gives us a discount on fresh vegetables.
Although discount coupons help households save money, they may also encourage consumers to buy unnecessary products.

col: redeem a coupon｜sử dụng phiếu giảm giá
tip: coupon chủ yếu là phiếu giảm giá; voucher thường chỉ phiếu trả trước.

senses.en: A product that makes hair softer and easier to manage.
A liquid added during washing to make fabrics softer.

ex.en: I use conditioner to keep my curly hair soft.
Consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing refillable containers for shampoo and conditioner products.

col: leave-in conditioner｜dầu xả không cần xả lại
tip: Đứng một mình thường chỉ dầu xả; máy điều hòa nói air conditioner.

senses.en: A statement explaining exactly what a word or concept means
How clearly the details of an image or sound appear

ex.en: Could you give me a simple definition of gravity?
A broader definition of health includes emotional wellbeing and social relationships, not merely the absence of physical illness.

col: a clear definition｜định nghĩa rõ ràng
tip: definition of dẫn ra khái niệm được định nghĩa; độ nét cao thường viết tắt là HD.

senses.en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance.
Generally accepted, regularly used, or meeting an established requirement.

ex.en: The food here is always of a high standard.
Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.

tip: Đạt tiêu chuẩn dùng meet a standard; mức sống dùng standard of living.

senses.en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit.
Inside something rather than outside it.

ex.en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.

col: within walking distance｜trong tầm đi bộ
within reach｜trong tầm với; có thể đạt được
within a week｜trong vòng một tuần
tip: within nhấn mạnh không vượt quá phạm vi; within a week là trong vòng một tuần.

senses.en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong

ex.en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.

col: punish someone for something｜phạt ai vì việc gì
punish offenders｜xử phạt người vi phạm
tip: punish sb for sth nghĩa là phạt ai vì việc gì.

senses.en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea
test ideas or methods to see what happens

ex.en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.

col: conduct an experiment｜tiến hành thí nghiệm
a controlled experiment｜thí nghiệm đối chứng
experiment with materials｜thử nghiệm với các vật liệu
tip: Động từ đi với with nghĩa là thử nghiệm; danh từ nhấn âm thứ nhất, động từ nhấn âm thứ hai.

senses.en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people.
A polite or formal way to refer to a man.

ex.en: A gentleman held the door open for us.
The elderly gentleman described how public transport had improved his independence and access to community activities.

col: a perfect gentleman｜một quý ông hoàn hảo
ladies and gentlemen｜thưa quý bà và quý ông
tip: Số nhiều là gentlemen; cách gọi trang trọng dành cho nam giới không nhất thiết nhấn mạnh phẩm hạnh.

senses.en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp
a steady pain that lasts for some time
to want something very deeply

ex.en: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.

col: a dull ache｜cơn đau âm ỉ
aches and pains｜đau nhức khắp người
tip: ache thường chỉ cơn đau âm ỉ kéo dài; pain là từ chung cho mọi cơn đau.

senses.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.
To be the same in quantity, value, or quality.

senses.zh: người ngang hàng; đối thủ ngang tài
senses.en: Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.

col: equal access｜quyền tiếp cận bình đẳng
equal to｜bằng; đủ sức đảm nhiệm
treat as an equal｜đối xử như người ngang hàng
tip: Tính từ thường đi với to; động từ equal nối thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm to.

senses.en: To give money, goods, or blood to help others

ex.en: We donate our spare blankets to the local shelter.
Businesses can reduce food waste by donating surplus products to charities that support vulnerable families.

col: donate money to charity｜quyên góp tiền cho tổ chức từ thiện
tip: Dùng donate something to someone, không dùng hai tân ngữ liền nhau.

senses.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
To leave a competition before finishing it.

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.

col: retire from a race｜bỏ cuộc trong cuộc đua
tip: retire là động từ; danh từ “việc nghỉ hưu” là retirement.

senses.en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing.
To state the price you will charge for something.
Repeated words from a source, or a stated price.

ex.en: My sister loves to quote lines from old films.
Students should quote reliable sources accurately and explain how the evidence supports their arguments in academic essays.

col: quote someone a price｜báo giá cho ai
a direct quote｜trích dẫn nguyên văn
tip: quote là trích nguyên văn; paraphrase là diễn đạt lại bằng lời của mình.

senses.zh: nhà thám hiểm; người thăm dò
senses.en: someone who travels through unfamiliar places to discover more about them

ex.en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.

col: polar explorer｜nhà thám hiểm vùng cực
intrepid explorer｜nhà thám hiểm gan dạ
early explorers｜những nhà thám hiểm đầu tiên
tip: explorer chỉ người thám hiểm, exploration chỉ hoạt động khám phá.

senses.en: words repeated exactly from another person or source
a statement of the expected price of goods or services

ex.en: She opened her speech with a quotation from a poem.
Before selecting a contractor, local authorities should obtain a detailed quotation for the proposed construction work.

col: request a quotation｜yêu cầu báo giá
provide a quotation｜cung cấp báo giá
tip: Lời trích từ ai hoặc tác phẩm nào dùng from; báo giá thường đi với for.

senses.en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.

ex.en: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.

col: a wrist injury｜chấn thương cổ tay
sprain your wrist｜bong gân cổ tay
a wrist support｜đai bảo vệ cổ tay
tip: Chữ w đầu từ không đọc; cổ tay là wrist, mắt cá chân là ankle.

senses.en: a word modifying a verb, adjective, adverb, or whole sentence

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to circle every adverb.
Understanding how an adverb changes emphasis can help language learners express their opinions more precisely.

col: adverb of frequency｜trạng từ chỉ tần suất
adverb of manner｜trạng từ chỉ cách thức
adverb placement｜vị trí của trạng từ
tip: adverb là danh từ; tính từ “thuộc trạng từ” là adverbial.

senses.en: To have to pay money back to someone.

senses.zh: phải đền đáp; mắc nợ ân tình
senses.en: To have a duty to give someone something.

senses.zh: nhờ vào; công lao thuộc về
senses.en: To have something because of someone's help or another cause.

ex.en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
Many successful students owe their progress to consistent practice rather than exceptional natural ability.

col: owe an apology｜nợ ai một lời xin lỗi
owe a debt of gratitude｜mang ơn sâu nặng
owe success to｜cho rằng thành công là nhờ
tip: owe A to B có thể là nợ B món A, cũng có thể là nhờ B mà có A.

senses.en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and aged in barrels.

ex.en: The guide showed us barrels used for ageing whisky.
Traditional whisky production attracts tourists to rural areas and supports employment in farming, manufacturing, and hospitality.

col: whisky distillery｜nhà máy chưng cất whisky
tip: Rượu của Scotland thường viết whisky, rượu của Ireland và Mỹ thường viết whiskey.

senses.en: A country considered together with its people
A people united by shared history, culture, or language

ex.en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
Wealthier nations should support international efforts to improve access to clean water in poorer regions.

col: developing nation｜quốc gia đang phát triển
the entire nation｜toàn thể nhân dân
tip: nation nhấn mạnh quốc gia và người dân; state thường nhấn mạnh chính quyền hoặc thực thể chính trị.

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

ex.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.

col: perform on stage｜biểu diễn trên sân khấu
perform a task｜thực hiện nhiệm vụ
tip: Có thể chỉ biểu diễn, cũng đi với task, duty để chỉ việc thực hiện.

senses.en: a comfortable room for sitting, relaxing, or waiting
a room in a home for sitting and relaxing
to sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way

ex.en: We waited in the lounge until our room was ready.
Comfortable airport lounges can make long journeys less stressful for passengers travelling with young children.

col: hotel lounge｜phòng nghỉ của khách sạn
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh còn chỉ phòng khách trong nhà; làm động từ thường đi với around.

senses.en: a hoofed wild animal whose males usually have branching antlers

ex.en: A deer stood quietly beside the forest path.
Protecting woodland habitats helps maintain healthy deer populations, but careful management is needed to prevent excessive grazing.

col: a herd of deer｜một đàn hươu
tip: deer có dạng số ít và số nhiều giống nhau: one deer, several deer.

senses.en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.

ex.en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.

col: recognise the importance of｜nhận ra tầm quan trọng của
tip: importance không đếm được; coi trọng điều gì dùng attach importance to.

senses.en: To have a plan or purpose in mind.

senses.zh: có ý; được thiết kế cho mục đích nào
senses.en: To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
The council intends to expand public transport services to reduce dependence on private cars.

col: intend to do something｜định làm gì
tip: intend to do nghĩa là định làm; be intended for nghĩa là dành cho.

senses.en: To crush something flat or squeeze into a small space
An indoor racket sport played by hitting a ball against walls
A vegetable with thick skin and a soft, seed-filled centre

ex.en: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.

tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh còn chỉ nước trái cây cô đặc cần pha loãng.

senses.en: painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin
upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.

tip: sore thường bổ nghĩa cho bộ phận cơ thể, như a sore throat.

senses.en: An exercise raising and lowering your body using your arms.

ex.en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
Simple exercises such as push-ups allow people to build strength without paying for expensive gym memberships.

col: a set of push-ups｜một hiệp hít đất
tip: Danh từ đếm được; tiếng Anh Anh cũng hay dùng press-up.

senses.en: A statement about what is expected to happen in the future.

ex.en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.

col: make a prediction｜đưa ra dự đoán
prediction comes true｜dự đoán trở thành sự thật
tip: Đưa ra dự đoán dùng make a prediction, không dùng do.

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information

senses.zh: nhân vật; bóng người; dáng người
senses.en: a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.

col: a leading figure｜nhân vật hàng đầu
a rough figure｜con số ước chừng
tip: Số liệu thường dùng số nhiều figures; figure out nghĩa là hiểu ra.

senses.en: a very hard mineral used in jewellery and cutting tools
a shape with four equal sides and opposite angles equal

ex.en: A tiny diamond sparkled on her silver ring.
The diamond industry faces growing pressure to demonstrate that its mining practices protect workers and local ecosystems.

tip: diamond chỉ kim cương; thuật ngữ hình học chính xác của hình thoi là rhombus.

senses.en: an older term for a female aircraft or ship attendant

ex.en: My grandmother worked as a stewardess before becoming a teacher.
The replacement of stewardess with flight attendant reflects a broader shift towards gender-neutral language in professional settings.

col: work as a stewardess｜làm nữ tiếp viên hàng không
airline stewardess｜nữ tiếp viên của hãng hàng không
tip: Cách gọi cũ và chỉ dành cho nữ; ngày nay thường dùng flight attendant.

senses.en: a plastic case containing magnetic tape for recording sound

ex.en: We found an old cassette of songs in the cupboard.
Before digital streaming became widespread, many language learners used cassette recordings to practise listening at home.

tip: Lưu ý nhấn âm thứ hai; máy phát gọi là cassette player.

senses.en: A wide-mouthed container, often glass, with a lid.

senses.zh: gây khó chịu; không ăn khớp
senses.en: To feel unpleasant or clash with something.
To shake suddenly and sharply, sometimes causing pain.

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.

col: a jar of honey｜một hũ mật ong
jar with the surroundings｜không hòa hợp với xung quanh
tip: jar thường là hũ miệng rộng có nắp; a jar of theo sau là thứ chứa bên trong.

senses.zh: đạt được; hoàn thành; thực hiện
senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.

col: achieve a goal｜đạt được mục tiêu
achieve a balance｜đạt được sự cân bằng
tip: Theo sau là mục tiêu hoặc kết quả, không nói achieve to do.

senses.en: containing a lot of moisture in the air

ex.en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.

tip: humid chủ yếu tả không khí hoặc khí hậu ẩm, không dùng cho quần áo ướt.

senses.en: the period of life when someone is young
young people considered as a group
a young man, especially a teenager

ex.en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.

col: youth unemployment｜thất nghiệp ở thanh niên
tip: Nghĩa “tuổi trẻ” thường không đếm được; a youth chỉ một thanh niên nam.

senses.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving

senses.zh: làm theo yêu cầu; đặt làm riêng
senses.en: made to meet a particular customer's needs

senses.zh: sự chiếu cố; việc mua hàng
senses.en: the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.

col: an ancient custom｜phong tục cổ xưa
custom furniture｜đồ nội thất đặt làm riêng
tip: custom là phong tục hoặc tập quán; customs còn có nghĩa là hải quan.

senses.en: so interesting that it holds your attention completely

ex.en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.

col: fascinating discovery｜phát hiện đầy cuốn hút
tip: Điều gì khiến người ta mê dùng fascinating; người bị mê hoặc dùng fascinated.

senses.en: The part of the day when there is natural light.
Happening or existing during the day rather than at night.

ex.en: The cat usually sleeps indoors during the daytime.
Higher daytime temperatures may force outdoor workers to adjust their schedules during the summer months.

col: daytime television｜chương trình truyền hình ban ngày
tip: Thường nói in the daytime; khi làm định ngữ thì không thêm the.

senses.en: in or to any place, regardless of where
used in questions to express surprise about a place

ex.en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.

col: wherever possible｜bất cứ nơi nào có thể
wherever you go｜dù bạn đi đâu
wherever you live｜dù bạn sống ở đâu
tip: Nghĩa “bất cứ nơi đâu” tương đương với no matter where.

senses.en: Your name written in your own distinctive way
Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place

ex.en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.

col: require a signature｜yêu cầu chữ ký
tip: signature thường là chữ ký; chữ ký của người nổi tiếng thường gọi là autograph.

senses.en: completely or without any doubt

senses.zh: đúng vậy; hoàn toàn đồng ý
senses.en: used to express strong agreement with someone

ex.en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.

tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho tính từ cực đoan như essential, ít nói absolutely good.

senses.en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape
to make someone do something against their wishes
physical strength used to control or overpower someone

ex.en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.

col: force someone to do something｜buộc ai làm gì
tip: “Ép ai làm gì” dùng force somebody to do something.

senses.en: Someone who deliberately and unlawfully kills another person.

ex.en: The detective finally identified the murderer in the novel.
Documentaries about convicted murderers should avoid sensationalism and consider the feelings of victims' families.

col: convicted murderer｜kẻ giết người bị kết án
identify the murderer｜xác định hung thủ
catch a murderer｜bắt kẻ giết người
tip: Chỉ người cố ý giết người trái pháp luật; killer có nghĩa rộng hơn.

senses.en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things
A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through
Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose

ex.en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
Governments should channel more funding into public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.

col: channel resources into｜dồn nguồn lực vào
tip: Khi là động từ thường dùng channel sth into sth, nghĩa là dồn nguồn lực vào đâu.

senses.zh: chuyện tình; tình yêu; không khí lãng mạn
senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love

senses.zh: tiểu thuyết lãng mạn; phim tình cảm
senses.en: a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.

col: a holiday romance｜mối tình kỳ nghỉ
a whirlwind romance｜mối tình chóng vánh
a sense of romance｜cảm giác lãng mạn
tip: Nói chung về tình yêu thường không đếm được; chỉ một mối tình hay một tác phẩm thì đếm được.

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.

tip: Cũng có cách đọc /raʊt/ trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; route nhấn mạnh tuyến đường đi.

senses.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.
Worth a large amount of money.

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.

col: a valuable contribution｜đóng góp quan trọng
tip: Đồ quý giá dùng số nhiều valuables; invaluable nghĩa là vô giá.

senses.zh: thuộc lịch sử; liên quan đến lịch sử
senses.en: connected with history or events in the past

ex.en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.

tip: historical chỉ liên quan đến lịch sử; historic nhấn mạnh có ý nghĩa lịch sử.

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.

senses.zh: sự vận hành; hoạt động; điều hành
senses.en: The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.

col: perform an operation｜tiến hành phẫu thuật
tip: Bộ phận được mổ nối bằng on: an operation on the knee.

senses.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.

senses.zh: quỹ ủy thác; tổ chức ủy thác
senses.en: An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.

col: trust someone to do something｜tin ai sẽ làm gì
tip: trust sb to do sth nghĩa là tin ai sẽ làm tốt việc gì.

senses.zh: buổi; khoảng thời gian hoạt động
senses.en: a period spent doing a particular activity
a formal meeting or period when an official body meets

ex.en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
Regular revision sessions help students retain information more effectively than studying intensively just before examinations.

col: a training session｜một buổi huấn luyện
a revision session｜một buổi ôn tập
tip: session chỉ khoảng thời gian hoạt động; semester mới thường chỉ học kỳ.

senses.zh: xe đa dụng cỡ nhỏ (chở người)
senses.en: A vehicle with several passenger seats, often used by families.
A small van used for transporting goods.

ex.en: Our minivan has enough seats for the whole family.
Shared minivan services can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who lack reliable public transport.

col: family minivan｜xe đa dụng gia đình
rent a minivan｜thuê một chiếc xe đa dụng
seven-seater minivan｜xe đa dụng bảy chỗ
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thường chỉ xe gia đình nhiều chỗ ngồi, không nên luôn hiểu là xe tải nhỏ.

senses.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

ex.en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.

col: unexpected delay｜sự chậm trễ bất ngờ
tip: unexpected nhấn mạnh điều không ngờ tới, không nhất thiết xảy ra đột ngột.

senses.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.

senses.zh: lá phiếu; cuộc bỏ phiếu; sự biểu quyết
senses.en: A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.

ex.en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.

col: cast a vote｜bỏ một lá phiếu
the right to vote｜quyền bỏ phiếu
tip: vote for nghĩa là ủng hộ; vote against nghĩa là phản đối.

senses.en: A fruit with creamy green flesh and a large central stone.

ex.en: She spread ripe avocado on her warm toast.
Growing demand for avocados can place pressure on water supplies in regions with limited rainfall.

tip: Số nhiều là avocados, không thêm -es.

senses.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.
Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.

ex.en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.

col: forgive someone for something｜tha thứ cho ai về việc gì
forgive a mistake｜tha thứ một lỗi lầm
tip: Dùng forgive sb for doing sth; quá khứ forgave, quá khứ phân từ forgiven.

senses.en: a vehicle that flies, such as a plane or helicopter

ex.en: A small aircraft flew low over the fields.
Developing more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption, although growing passenger demand may limit the environmental benefits.

tip: aircraft có dạng số ít và số nhiều giống nhau, không thêm -s.

senses.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling

senses.zh: gánh nặng tâm lý; hành trang tình cảm
senses.en: past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties

ex.en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.

tip: Không đếm được; một món hành lý nói a piece of baggage.

senses.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.

col: generous donation｜khoản quyên góp hào phóng
generous with your time｜không tiếc thời gian
tip: be generous with sth nghĩa là hào phóng về điều gì.

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.

senses.zh: làn sóng; dòng người hoặc vật ồ ạt đổ đến
senses.en: A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.

col: a flood of complaints｜một loạt khiếu nại ồ ạt
tip: Phát âm có nguyên âm giống blood, không vần với food.

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.

col: an urban fox｜cáo sống ở thành phố
tip: Khi là động từ nghĩa là “làm khó”, chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh thân mật.

senses.zh: độ C; thuộc nhiệt giai Celsius
senses.en: Using the temperature scale with water freezing at zero

ex.en: It was thirty degrees centigrade in the shade today.
A rise of two degrees centigrade in average temperatures could significantly affect agricultural production in vulnerable regions.

tip: Thường nói degrees centigrade; khoa học hiện đại hay dùng Celsius hơn.

senses.en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation
showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone

ex.en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.

col: a typical example｜ví dụ điển hình
a typical day｜một ngày bình thường
tip: typical of dùng để nói điều gì là đặc trưng của ai hoặc vật gì.

senses.en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.

ex.en: We used colourful wooden shapes in geometry class today.
Learning geometry helps students develop spatial reasoning skills that are valuable in engineering and architecture.

tip: Tên môn học, không đếm được; thường không dùng mạo từ.

senses.zh: lặp đi lặp lại; nhiều lần
senses.en: happening or done again and again

senses.zh: lặp lại; nhắc lại (quá khứ/quá khứ phân từ)
senses.en: said or did something again

ex.en: Repeated phone calls kept interrupting our quiet dinner.
Repeated exposure to new vocabulary helps learners remember words and use them more confidently.

col: repeated warnings｜những lời cảnh báo lặp đi lặp lại
repeated exposure to｜tiếp xúc nhiều lần với
tip: repeated nhấn mạnh xảy ra nhiều lần; repetitive thường hàm ý đơn điệu, nhàm chán.

senses.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.

col: relaxed atmosphere｜bầu không khí thoải mái
create an atmosphere｜tạo bầu không khí
tip: Nói về một bầu không khí thường dùng an atmosphere; khí quyển Trái Đất dùng the atmosphere.

senses.zh: hội đồng; hội đồng địa phương
senses.en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.

ex.en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
The city council should consult residents before approving developments that could affect public green spaces.

tip: council là hội đồng; counsel là lời khuyên hoặc tư vấn.

senses.en: to make someone eager to do something

senses.zh: là động cơ của; thúc đẩy
senses.en: to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.

col: motivate someone to do something｜thúc đẩy ai làm gì
highly motivated｜có động lực rất cao
be motivated by｜bị thúc đẩy bởi
tip: Thường dùng motivate sb to do; sau by là động cơ.

senses.zh: sự bực bội; sự khó chịu
senses.en: the feeling of being annoyed

senses.zh: sự kích ứng; sự viêm khó chịu
senses.en: soreness or discomfort in a part of the body

ex.en: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.

col: a source of irritation｜nguồn gây bực bội
tip: Có thể chỉ cảm xúc bực bội, cũng có thể chỉ da hoặc bộ phận cơ thể bị kích ứng.

senses.en: A large hole in the ground
An area where racing cars stop for servicing
The hard central part of certain fruits

ex.en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.

col: a pit stop｜dừng xe để bảo dưỡng
tip: Khu bảo dưỡng thường dùng the pits; nghĩa “hạt quả” chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ.

senses.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values

senses.zh: triết lý sống; quan điểm chỉ đạo
senses.en: A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions

ex.en: My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.

col: personal philosophy｜triết lý sống cá nhân
philosophy of education｜triết học giáo dục
tip: Chỉ môn học thì thường không đếm được; chỉ một hệ quan điểm cụ thể có thể dùng a philosophy.

senses.en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

ex.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.

col: send someone on an errand｜sai ai chạy việc
a quick errand｜việc vặt làm nhanh
tip: Thường chỉ đi ra ngoài làm việc nhỏ; hay đi với run errands.

senses.zh: tuyệt đẹp; gây ấn tượng mạnh
senses.en: extremely beautiful or impressive
causing great surprise or shock

ex.en: We enjoyed a stunning view from the hilltop.
The region's stunning coastal scenery attracts visitors, but increased tourism places pressure on fragile ecosystems.

col: a stunning achievement｜một thành tựu đáng kinh ngạc
a stunning victory｜một chiến thắng gây sửng sốt
tip: stunning tả sự vật gây kinh ngạc; stunned tả người sững sờ.

senses.en: a thick sweet liquid made from dissolved sugar
a sweet thick liquid containing medicine

ex.en: She poured a little syrup over her warm pancakes.
Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.

col: fruit in syrup｜trái cây ngâm siro
tip: Thường không đếm được; siro ho nói cough syrup.

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ thường dùng forecast, cũng có thể dùng forecasted.

senses.zh: làn khói hoặc hơi nhỏ; luồng hơi
senses.en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly.
To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort.
To release air or smoke, or swell with air.

ex.en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.

col: a puff of smoke｜một làn khói
tip: Một làn khói dùng a puff of smoke; puff cũng có nghĩa là thở hổn hển.

senses.en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products.
A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something.
To register a name or symbol for legal protection.

ex.en: The bakery's trademark is a tiny golden wheat stalk.
Registering a trademark helps small businesses protect their identity and distinguish their products from those of competitors.

col: registered trademark｜nhãn hiệu đã đăng ký
tip: Nhãn hiệu là trademark; bản quyền là copyright, đối tượng bảo hộ khác nhau.

senses.en: Products applied to the face or body to improve appearance.

ex.en: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bathroom drawer.
Consumers increasingly expect cosmetics manufacturers to disclose ingredients clearly and reduce unnecessary packaging to limit environmental damage.

col: cosmetics manufacturer｜nhà sản xuất mỹ phẩm
tip: Thường dùng số nhiều; tính từ cosmetic cũng có nghĩa là mang tính bề ngoài.
